IN.label: Additional US tariff on India-origin goods
IN.note: After the Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs (Learning Resources v. Trump, Feb 20 2026), India's IEEPA rate (up to 50%) stopped being collected. Secondary sources report a temporary Section 122 rate of 10% and, from Jul 24 2026, about 10% on top of normal duty, but they conflict. Re-check before shipping.
